def find_screen_height(width, ratio):
    # Split the ratio string into width and height components
    ratio_width, ratio_height = map(int, ratio.split(':'))
    
    # Calculate the height based on the given width and aspect ratio
    height = (width * ratio_height) // ratio_width
    
    # Return the dimensions as a formatted string
    return f'{width}x{height}'
